meaning: 对某事/某物非常慷慨大方
usageNote: 形容词短语！跟compliments/money/time这类词搭配超自然，语气是夸人大方、不吝啬～

examples.en: She is very generous with her compliments, always making people feel valued.
examples.zh: 她对赞美之词毫不吝啬，总让人感到被重视。

examples.en: My grandpa was very generous with his time, teaching us something new every day.
examples.zh: 我爷爷非常慷慨地付出时间，每天都教我们新东西。
